description: This source file contains unit tests for the GatewayConnectionIssue detection logic in the OpenClaw project. It tests various scenarios of gateway connection issues and verifies the detection output.

classes.name: GatewayConnectionIssueTests
classes.description: A test suite for GatewayConnectionIssue detection functions, verifying its behavior across different gateway error scenarios.
